criteria.criterion: Window/opening placement, counts, rhythm, proportions, frames and glazing divisions
deductions: Uniform four-row small-window arrangement replaces lower tall, middle wide and upper short Gatewood families. Historic bar also lacks correct tall main and short upper row proportions.
Several angled/return faces are entirely blank; source photos and aerial show varied window rhythms. No complete source-backed opening count has been established.

Only one generic portal is present. Its object name says Gatewood but its position on the long 1932 bar corresponds to historic portal. It lacks gridded fanlight, carved layered stone, moulded bases, stone two-line name field and relief crest.

Separate Gatewood portal with brick-filled arched head, stone keystone, pier profiles, deep recess and 2011 plaque is not resolved on stepped wing. Current accessible approaches and secondary entrances are absent or unverified.

criteria.criterion: Overall proportions, wings/setbacks, roof form and silhouette
deductions: Full 117.03 by 91.80m shell has a uniform18.5m top and0.25m flat roof. Multiple lower wings, hipped sloping perimeter roofs, parapets and rooftop enclosures are represented only by an overhead texture. Texture does not reproduce silhouette.
Footprint outline is recognizable, but roof voids/roof elevations and five-wing height relationships need segmentation. No measured wing heights accepted.

criteria.criterion: Material/color fidelity, surface scale, trim and facade depth
deductions: Brick/stone/dark-glazing palette and masonry texture give partial identity. Broad white strips and plain surrounds omit projecting belt profiles, soldier heads, decorated spandrels, deep eaves and old/new stone distinctions.

Source roof image bakes lighting and roof detail onto a single flat plane. Glass is uniformly very dark and lacks observed facade-specific divisions/reflection. Colors remain qualitative under different lighting.

criteria.criterion: Whole-building visual consistency across all elevations and matched oblique views
deductions: All model elevations and two obliques inspected, but repeated grids and blank returns do not follow source wing-specific architecture. Rear/service/court current photographic evidence remains insufficient. No calibrated matched camera poses are available.
